name: Overture Places Knowledge Enrichment
description: Enriches place cards with brand, multilingual names, addresses, and contact details from Overture Maps Places

overture.purpose: Match a clicked OSM place to its Overture twin to fill in brand identity, multilingual names, addresses, contact details, and Wikidata cross-reference
overture.dataSent: No end-user data is sent; place coordinates and identifiers are compared with the locally ingested Overture snapshot

foursquare.purpose: Provide additional venue brand and contact data for commercial places via the Overture Places dataset (Foursquare is one of the Overture contributing sources)
foursquare.dataSent: No data sent directly to Foursquare; data is accessed via the locally-ingested Overture Places snapshot

meta-places.purpose: Provides place attributes distributed through Overture Maps
meta-places.dataSent: No data is sent directly to Meta
